changelog: Phase 2 Stage 1 release-pipeline-gap fix (incident df7a7ff8). The v1.77.10 source code was tagged on 2026-04-27 but binaries were never built/published and no agent_releases row was inserted — see issue #12 backstory. This release publishes the v1.77.10 binaries that should have shipped 2026-04-27 (rebuilt fresh from the unchanged agent source) and inserts the matching agent_releases row, lifting the Wave 1 announcement gate. Surviving fleet (currently on 1.77.3/1.77.4) can now upgrade to 1.77.10 via the existing self-poll path. Server convention going forward: installers/version.json reflects the published agent binary version; package.json reflects the server/repo version. They diverge for server-only releases (e.g., v1.77.15-17 were server-only and did not change agent binaries).
